Cc: procurement@premierhealth.com

Subject: Premier Health — Onsite workshop (Dec 8–9): travel exceptions request

Hi Tessa / Lauren,

Thanks again for moving quickly on the Dec 8–9 executive workshop in Chicago. A couple of last-minute items from our side that need quick alignment so travel can be booked this week:

- Two executive attendees (CEO Elena Ruiz and VP Product David Shah) need to arrive a day early (Dec 7) for prep; Premier policy only covers nights for scheduled meeting days.
- Both would like single rooms with a confirmed guarantee for early check-in; standard rate is fine but they prefer a one-category upgrade if available.
- We may need flexibility on ticket change fees for one of the flights (possible client-side schedule change).

Can Redwood confirm whether an exception to standard travel policy (early night + one-category room upgrade + change-fee waiver) is acceptable and who will absorb incremental cost? If Redwood prefers, we can split incremental hotel nights/upgrades 50/50; alternatively, we can provide a PO if Redwood requires Premier to pay directly.

Attached: draft itinerary (premier_itinerary_v3.pdf), attendee list (attendee_list.csv).

Appreciate a quick confirmation — bookings ideally by EOD Wednesday so we don’t lose corporate rates.

Best,
Elena
Elena Ruiz
Director, Strategic Partnerships
Premier Health

Thanks Elena — looping in Finance (Vanessa) to confirm cost allocation and Marcus (cc'd below) for final sign-off. A few quick clarifying Qs so we can approve without back-and-forth:

1) Please confirm names/titles of the two execs who need Dec 7 night (I have CEO "Elena Ruiz" and VP Product "David Shah" on the attendee list but will double-check).
2) Are you asking for one-category room upgrades only? Any preference for refundable vs. non-refundable fares?
3) If Premier is open to a partial split, can you confirm what % you would cover? (Elena suggested 50/50 — note that is fine from a sales standpoint but Finance needs to confirm exact dollar cap.)

If you can reply with the three bullets above, I’ll put together a short cost estimate and route to Marcus for sign-off. If urgent, we can approve a capped exception (e.g., up to $3,500 total incremental) now and reconcile after PO arrives.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan

Elena / Tessa — quick add from AE side:

- Confirming the two execs: Elena Ruiz (CEO) and David Shah (VP Product). Both will need Dec 7 night and early check-in.
- Upgrade request: one-category room upgrade is sufficient (executive floor ok).
- Flights: prefer refundable or changeable fares for one inventoried flight; cost estimate below.

Estimated incremental cost (ballpark):
- 1 extra night (King room, exec floor): $420/night x 2 rooms = $840
- One-category upgrade fee (hotel admin): $60/room = $120
- Change-fee buffer (refundable fare delta): ~$1,750 for two fares
Total incremental: ~$2,710

I recommend approving up to $3,000 cap. Sales is comfortable covering up to $2,000 of that for customer experience given deal momentum; if Finance prefers a different split, happy to update the mutual action plan. Marcus — can Finance sign off on Redwood absorbing $2,000 and Premier covering the remainder (~$710) or would you prefer we request a PO?

Thanks — I’ll pause bookings until we have verbal sign-off.

—Lauren Bishop
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Thanks team. Finance has reviewed the estimate and a few notes before we can provide formal sign-off:

- We will approve a one-time exception for the extra night + one-category upgrade for the two executives, capped at $3,000 total incremental. Redwood is prepared to cover up to $2,000 of that amount.
- Condition: we need either a PO from Premier referencing deal PH-2026-7892 or a signed SOW confirming cost split within 7 days of booking. If we do not receive a PO/SOW within 7 days, Redwood reserves the right to invoice Premier for the full incremental amount.
- Please add a cost-center code for this spend: CC-ENT-2026.
- Jason (TravelCorp) — attached is the travel quote (quote_travelcorp_20261129.pdf). Can you confirm refundable fare options for the two flights and hold the room block at the corporate rate? Also confirm change-fee waiver terms in writing.

Vanessa/Accounts Payable will track once the PO is received. If Procurement at Premier can issue the PO quickly, bookings can proceed to lock rates.

—Marcus Lin
